sections.content:
4 in-class open book quizzes (輕鬆滿分，其實係攞嚟take attendance)
1 Lab/week (頭幾個係輕鬆，但之後最好每次都做prelab)
Written midterm (要操少少卷，唔難)
Lab midterm (難度較高，平時做lab要專心d)
Final project (都唔少人滿分/接近滿分) + report (report輕鬆滿分)

內容好有條理，由淺至深 (但係深極都唔難，話曬係introduction)。midterm前個人覺得KVL KCL小小複雜，加埋要記唔同IC既功能要話d時間，不過只要操一操pastpaper，written mid term都ok輕鬆。

midterm後開始教d logic，記住要認真聽。因為我個時以為唔洗再考試所以冇乜專心，不過之後project唔識做，到頭來都係要自己睇翻lecture notes。

project記住預早開始，因為一定會有好多你預期唔到既bug。同埋lab partner好重要。lab partner好重要。lab partner好重要。如果佢freeride你，你好大獲。記住代眼揀partner。
sections.teaching:
有得揀一定要揀professor song
上堂講野清晰，氣氛好，解釋concept仔細。
落堂得閒仲會去lab度睇學生，add佢facebook仲可以問問題，呢d其實唔係佢份外事。我都幾佩服佢咁比心機教書。
sections.grading: 屎忽痕打呢篇野既時候未派grade所以唔知。
sections.workload:
midterm前workload 3-3.5 cred
midterm後做project workload 4.5-5 cred

其實作為4cred course我覺得都可接受。而且chur完真係學到野。

sections.content:
Contains 8-9 labs...which actually teaches everything for the final project demonstration. The tutorials are a must, since you get to know of the quizzes and way to work in the labs. Teaches the lab equipment handling skills. At last, the project is there which allows you to have a first hand experience of robotics, circuits etc.

One midterm...written
Labs are marked
3 quizzes (very easy for regular class participants)
sections.teaching: The lectures can get a bit boring, but the professor I got (Mr. Antonelli), was very friendly and helped me clear all my doubts. A special heads up for Yimeng, TANG. She helped me the most during the course and never hesitated to stay back during tutorial/labs to clear my doubts.
sections.grading: The grading is very fair and accurate. You are graded according to your work. Point to point mark.
sections.workload: The workload can be extensive at times, particularly towards the project deadline, as you have to work to get it done. Be sure to keep your robot secured since I had mine destroyed days before the competition by some *insert the description here*. Course demands attention and for a good grade, have to work hard.

sections.content: Content are simple, just basic physic, so everyone can be able to handle them.
sections.teaching: Prof.Fan did a good job in teaching. Well I slept alot during the class but that wasn't his fault. He did put effort in it.
sections.grading:
You should have heard of it by now....
One of the best in term of grading.....
You should study the midterm exam because there are quite much of luck factor in the final project so it's safer to do as well as you can in midterm.
sections.workload: Final project can be harsh if you enter the lab in the last 3 days. If you give it time and effort it should be ok.

sections.content: You could really learn a lot after taking this course. The best part of ELEC1100 is the lab,where you get a chance to apply the knowledge from lectures. If you have already learnt some basic Highschool knowledge in Physics about electric circuit, the content won't be hard at all to be honest.
sections.teaching:
For me, Prof.SIN's spoke too slowly that I often fell asleep. Or maybe because I was taking his 9AM class. But the nice thing about him is that he is always willing to answer questions, so just go and ask him!

By the way, another important thing is to ask the TA,who will be in charge of all the exams and the final project. Any time you have a question in your mind, just throw it to the TA. My TA was really helpful.
sections.grading: The grades are good(Premise:if you work hard enough) You can definitely get nearly all full marks in Written Midterm,Lab Midterm,Quiz and the Final Project. In my opinion, its just a matter of attitude. You will get your deserved grades as long as you really work hard on this course.
sections.workload:
As mentioned in the Grading section, the workload depends. If you want to get a good grade, you need to shed sweat and put time and effort into it.

Also you need to take the Labs seriously. Though you could count on your "almighty, super nerdy, all A+"groupmate, you will have to take the lab midterm on your own. At that time, you will realize whether you have truly learnt the skills or not.

sections.content: space里这么多英文版的评论我就写一份中文版的satisfy一下大陆同学。这个课还是很不错的，作为一个introduction course，没有final考试，final P做一个小车，肯蹲实验室几天就好。不懂就问，有人负责好好解答你的问题。唯一的问题是大多数人（反正我就是）以前都没有接触过板子，所以插起电路来比较陌生，debug能力为零，面对bug比较慌。但反正要走出这一步，我今年的龟是A+（主要还是抱腿抱得好）。嗯，总之比较推荐这门课。另外space里也有我的联系方式，如果有什么further needs尽管联系我。
sections.teaching: SIN是不错的教授，他是local中英语非常够意思的，语速也慢，听懂没问题。也很关心学生，我一直跟他聊电子的发展方向（虽然最后的结果是我决定不报ECE了233）。上课没听懂的尽管问，讲到你懂。再说一下TA，我也不知道为什么带我们的TA基本都做gym，我老能遇见他们，所以混的熟，毕竟也是在ust读书的phD，最后final P还约了TA单独请教，总之这门课教学挺好的。
sections.grading: 给龟不错。不得不承认有特殊情况，我有朋友的车子最后demo的时候崩了，非常意外地烂龟了，不过据我所知大多数人还是不错的，所以我给了B。
sections.workload: 如果好好学，各个element都知道干嘛的，final project不是事儿。但如果最后突击的话，workload还是挺大的。起码与偶两个星期的时间，基本需要你天天晚上往实验室跑。不过工院的同志们，应该适应坐lab吧~

sections.content: 內容並不複雜，但是如果想的高分就要好好聽講，下課拿著筆記多想一想。lecture一開始的內容非常簡單，但是到期中以後從邏輯門開始的一些內容具有一定難度。tutorial是用來幫助你完成實驗課程的，雖然我沒去上過幾次，但是肯定有用，而且最後幾次很重要，關係到你的小車邏輯電路的設計。lecture和tutorial的最終目的都是為了final Project。
sections.teaching: 這門課只有第一節是課程上標記的老師講的，後面所有的lecture都是一個意大利小哥Marco上的。英語發音中有一種濃濃的意大利風情，反正我聽了好幾節課才能習慣並且聽懂。他講的非常細，而且會很耐心地解答同學們的問題。
sections.grading:
我們那個學期評分方式：quiz:10% labs:20%，written midterm：20%
lab midterm：15%  project：35%。
lab midterm是個考驗，前幾節lab一定要多動手，別全讓同學幫著做，要不然會跪。
對了，還有三個小quiz，會在lecture上出現，不會提前告知，會打你一個措手不及，所以不要翹課。
sections.workload: 我覺得workload是因人而異的。畢竟是工院的課，debug是永恆的旋律。final project的bug少，通過率高，自然就workload少。提別要提醒大家兩點：第一，給邏輯電路debug時，要測一下每個點的電壓，這樣很快就知道哪條線不對或者那個IC是壞的。第二，小車的邏輯電路設計特別重要，不要怎麼簡單怎麼來，複雜一點沒關係，到後來demo的時候就會順利很多！

sections.content: These course will teach you the basics of electronics, and the skills and design of a basic robotics system(e.g. how to use sensors and the signal they produced to guide the robot). It is a enjoyable course as you will have chance to implement the knowledge you learn in classes and labs to the final project and build something real.
sections.teaching: Professor Song is a very knowledgeable and nice teacher, he will alway answer your questions and explain difficult topic very clearly. You will definitely enjoy his lesson.
sections.grading: Student usually will do pretty well in lab and quizzes(close to full marks), so if you need to get A range you have to do well in your robot project, midterm and final.
sections.workload:
Assignment:
There are no assignments for this course.
Quiz:
There will be two or three quizzes for this course, but it will be very simple as you can even use your phone to search the answer on the net(officially).
Lab:
There will be a lab everyweek, so you need to read a lab manual and play around with the bread board once a week.
Project:
When it reaches the last three weeks of the course, you need to start working on the group project on building your line following car. These will be the most demanding weeks in the course so be prepare for it.

sections.content: Content related to basics of electronic engineering. Can get a little confusing to first time students studying electronics.
sections.teaching: Teaching was decent. There was a lack of interest on my part.
sections.grading: Grading was bad. For the amount of work I put in to the final grade, it was not that good as it is a very competitive course.
sections.workload: A few home works and pre-laboratoriess. The main aim of the course was to design a robot car which would work after following a white line. The midterm was really hard, especially the practical part.

sections.content: Although different from a typical first electronics course, ELEC 1100 is almost fully designed for the aim of the final project. General notions in the beginning, then useful information for the project. The labs are well designed and relatively well structured.
sections.grading: The class is really competitive. Do not ignore the bonus in the labs, and work on time management before exams. As for the project, make sure to have a good logic. Don't trust the sensors !
sections.workload: Heavy, but enjoyable if you are/become interested in electronics. Prepare yourself for all-nights in the lab if you don't start with a good logic. Spend more time on the logic design ! Make sure to make one that relies the least on the sensors.

Written midterm 20%
Lab midterm (15%)

Final project 35% total with 30% demo, 5% project report
sections.workload: There is a considerable amount of workload because if you do not prepare for your examinations, the mean goes high. Also, remember to get a decent and hard-working partner, else you will be in a fix.

呢科冇Final 亦代表Project越早做越好 少一科煩惱

每一個禮拜都有lab，基本上做嘅嘢唔難，但係好q煩。而且有Bonus分"鼓勵"你兩個鐘頭之內做完，基於我幾次都係孤軍作戰嘅關係，搏命都未必趕得切。所以事實證明揀啱groupmate係好重要架

隨機Quiz 係最hihi嘅地方之一 不過好在全部都係喺堂尾考 遲到都無事

不過冇final都有好處 就係mt以後基本唔駛聽書 做project嘅時候對住notes做就得
Demo攞滿分一定要用flip flop + 普通logic gate 除此之外就係 trial and error 試到得為止 :)
Debug到treegun就不在話下啦 尤其是對住堆19 sensor都咪話唔辛苦 在此小弟需再次強調 找一個好的groupmate是很重要的

總結而言 以1字頭course而言頗chur 不過同上堂以外精彩絕倫嘅"活力生活"比較 我覺得都算係咁…

sections.content:
這門課的LectureTimeslot是很靈活的。因為即使你reg進了一個堂你也可以隨時去另一個堂聽課。雖然課上會有突如其來的quiz，等同是attendance，但是你可以早上睡過一個quiz馬上下午到另一個堂上補回來，都是可以的。比如我這學期就是reg進了周一和周三的九點宋勝輝堂（畢竟這兩個堂選的人稍微少點，考慮到競爭會不那麽激烈）然後周三的九點堂常常睡過，於是就去補周五中午12點的施林堂。第一次quiz周三的睡過去了，星期五去補上了，毫無壓力。

然後課程內容簡單易懂，結合中學的電路知識可以很輕松地理解。

Lab很重要。畢竟是個ELEC課，重點全在動手。Lab是累積性的，也就是說之前Lab做好的基礎工程在之後會用到，每次Lab基本上都是在上一次的結果上疊加，所以一定要養成好習慣1.剪線盡量剛剛夠長度，導線盡量貼著底部，這樣就算後面的邏輯電路的線飛得到處都是也不至於和之前的基礎工程搞混2.IC盡量放得靠近些，節省空間，否則之後你會發現沒有地方放邏輯。。。

說說Project。其實我在開工之前請教了很多高人，他們的經驗對我影響不小。一開始我執著地相信他們的做法，從沒有懷疑過，所以走了很多彎路。然而最後發現就我的Project而言得改很多地方才能夠達到效果。果然自己的project還是得自己做，自己不斷嘗試，不斷debug，不斷總結才行。所以keepin mind兩點 1.不要只顧著求新求異，任何新異的設計都應該有實用性的理由支持，而不是全憑借想象設計2.得做好花時間的心理準備，不要妄圖一夜之間就做好，很多時候都是一個設計不行又改一個設計，很多出現的意外和不穩定性都得絞盡腦汁思考解決方案。刷夜不是必須的（我就沒刷過），但是你得把整個做project的period放長，因為很多時候一個新問題暴露出來你往往不能在在lab的幾個小時之內參透並且解決，反而是回hall睡一覺起來甚至洗澡的時候突然想通。。。所以每次去Lab不一定要刷夜打持久戰，我覺得先想好一個idea之後，去到lab集中幾個小時實現這個idea之後test幾圈debug一下就可以回去了，隔天再來就好。個人認為效率高於刷夜。OwO
sections.teaching: 宋勝輝喜歡手寫白板，講得好，規規矩矩，深入淺出，不緊不慢。施林給人感覺有點基。。。。施林在每個lecture會做一個SHILecture講人生，還挺有意思的。施林比宋勝輝愛開玩笑一點，但是有時候會冷場。。。。然後施林有點強迫癥，下面有人講話他一定會停下來，不說話，望著下面，等人都閉嘴才繼續。宋勝輝常常出現在Lab，很平易近人的一個人，我還在lab裏晚上10點左右跟他探討如何設計RC延時電路的問題，雖然最後因為找到替代方案而且實驗室裏面沒有PNP三極管（因為他們設計的lab不用所以沒有買過QwQ）所以沒有做。我還是更愛宋勝輝一些OwO，所以最後都只去他的堂了，雖然是9點堂QwQ。

sections.content: 頭幾堂係學番啲好基本嘅電路野,例如current, voltage, resistance. 跟住就教唔同嘅IC(integrated circuit), Kirchhoff's circuit law, logic gate, transistor, PWM, etc...

有midterm但無final, 所以midterm之後無上過堂.

sections.content:
PPTs and notes exist and are sufficient. Lab Notes are comprehensive. But you have to figure out the 'why' of everything yourself. The beginning is slow paced and easy to understand. If you're unfamiliar with the breadboard the practicals may take time getting used to.

Oh and do attend lectures because you never know when the four surprise quizzes might surprise you. And they should be an easy 8 percent
sections.teaching: For those who have not studied this previously, the basics were not explained. Prof may have been good, but the teaching left a lot to be desired. So really, it's a trap for newbies who want to know bout elec but have no background and skill.
sections.grading:
Fair and square
For a good grade in practicals, choose lab partner carefully.
Written exams/quizzes needs a good logical understanding and (memorization of) what connects to what in which circuit.
I really do not recall the mean grade.
sections.workload: Heavy because of the number of hours of slogging away in the laboratory every week and towards the end of the sem for the final project (literally day and night). But as exhilarating it is to watch your robot race, it'll be frustrating if you can't finish in time, because you've sacrificed precious hours for a low grade.
